svg.title: Map of the seven churches in Asia Minor
svg.desc: The western coast of Asia Minor and the Aegean islands. Patmos lies off the coast to the south-west. The seven churches, in the order of the letters of Revelation 2 and 3: Ephesus on the coast, then north to Smyrna and Pergamos, inland to Thyatira, south-east to Sardis and Philadelphia, and Laodicea furthest east.
